title: Vampire hunt
noInput: The input is not responding — nothing to measure with.
stepBaseline: Leave everything as usual. Measuring the background for 30 seconds…
stepSwitch: Now switch off or unplug ONE device and press “Switched off” right away.
stepAfter: Measuring after switch-off, 30 seconds — don't switch anything else…
fewSamples: Too few readings in 30 seconds — the connection dropped. Try again.
perMonth: Round the clock that is ≈ {energy} a month
rose: Power rose by {power} — something switched on. Try again.
notSeen: The difference {power} is below what the meter tells from noise ({floor}). The device draws next to nothing, or something else switched during the test.
listNote: The list is kept in this browser.
exportHint: Exporting now: the sun moves the power more than a standby device draws. Hunt in the evening or at night for best results.
intro: How it works: I measure the background for 30 seconds while everything is as usual. Then you switch off ONE device (or unplug it) and press “Switched off” — another 30 seconds without it. The difference is what it draws on standby. Most accurate when nothing switches on by itself (evening or night).
floorNow: Right now the meter can tell steps above {floor} from noise. Smaller ones won't show.
